moworks.notes: The camera turns, it does not move: every layer shifts by the same amount (no parallax), or the scene's inner box turns rotateY 0 -> 6 deg at most, 2000 ms easeInOutSine. Demo: all layers translate together 120 px (x -60 -> +60) over 2.6 s ease-in-out, beside the truck demo for comparison. Params: duration (2 s) · angle (≤ 6°) · ease (sine.inOut).
